# Letter of Intent — Small Multifamily Acquisition
## How to Use
Fill every [BRACKETED] slot before sending. This template is non-binding and modeled on
standard commercial LOI practice. Have a Louisiana real estate attorney review before
you send your first one — particularly the financing contingency, extension mechanics,
and entity/assignment language, which vary by deal. "Ridgeback Peak Properties LLC or
assigns" preserves the right to designate a per-deal SPE as the actual buyer at closing
without renegotiating the LOI.

---

[DATE]

[SELLER FULL LEGAL NAME]
[SELLER ADDRESS LINE 1]
[SELLER ADDRESS LINE 2]

Re: Non-Binding Letter of Intent — [PROPERTY ADDRESS], [CITY], LA [ZIP]

Dear [SELLER NAME / "To Whom It May Concern"],

Ridgeback Peak Properties LLC ("Purchaser") is pleased to submit this non-binding Letter
of Intent to purchase the above-referenced property on the following terms. This LOI does
not constitute a binding agreement; a binding obligation arises only upon execution of a
formal Purchase Agreement by both parties.

---

### 1. Property
[PROPERTY ADDRESS], [CITY], Louisiana [ZIP]; APN [PARCEL ID]; approximately [# UNITS]
residential units on [LAND SF / ACRES], more particularly described in the deed of
record. (The "Property.")

### 2. Purchase Price
[SPELL OUT PURCHASE PRICE, e.g., "Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($750,000)"],
payable as follows:
- Earnest Money Deposit: $[AMOUNT] delivered to [TITLE COMPANY] within [10] business
  days of mutual execution of the Purchase Agreement, applied to Purchase Price at closing.
- Balance: cash/loan proceeds at closing.

### 3. Due Diligence Period
Purchaser shall have [60 / 90 / 180] calendar days from Seller's delivery of all
documents listed in Section 4 below (the "DD Start Date") to complete due diligence
(the "DD Period"). Seller shall deliver said documents within [5] business days of
mutual execution of the Purchase Agreement.

If Purchaser terminates during the DD Period for any reason, the Earnest Money Deposit
is fully refundable. After expiration of the DD Period without termination, the Earnest
Money Deposit becomes non-refundable.

### 4. Document Delivery (starts DD clock)
Seller to deliver within [5] business days of Purchase Agreement execution:
- (a) Current rent roll with unit number, tenant name, lease start/end, monthly rent,
  deposit held, and any concessions.
- (b) Trailing 12-month income and expense statement (T-12).
- (c) Copies of all current leases, addenda, and month-to-month agreements.
- (d) Most recent [2] years of real property tax bills.
- (e) Insurance loss runs for the prior [3] years.
- (f) Most recent utility bills (water/sewer/electric/gas) for landlord-paid utilities.
- (g) Any environmental reports, surveys, or inspection reports in Seller's possession.
- (h) Current mortgage statement(s) showing outstanding balances (if any).

Failure to deliver any item within [5] business days delays the DD Start Date by one day
per day of delay.

### 5. Closing
Closing shall occur [30] calendar days after expiration of the DD Period (the "Closing
Date"), subject to satisfaction of all conditions. Time is of the essence.

### 6. Financing Contingency
This LOI is contingent upon Purchaser obtaining financing satisfactory to Purchaser in
its sole discretion on or before [DATE / "the end of the DD Period"]. If Purchaser has
not received a loan commitment on acceptable terms by such date, Purchaser may terminate
this agreement and receive a full refund of the Earnest Money Deposit.

### 7. Per-Diem Extension Option
Purchaser may extend the Closing Date by up to [2] periods of [15] days each by
delivering written notice to Seller [3] business days prior to the then-current Closing
Date and paying a non-refundable extension fee of $[AMOUNT] per extension period, which
[shall / shall not] be applied to the Purchase Price at closing.

### 8. Title and Survey
Seller shall convey marketable fee simple title by [warranty / special warranty] deed,
free and clear of all liens and encumbrances except [current-year taxes, HOA, and
permitted exceptions acceptable to Purchaser]. Purchaser shall order title commitment and
survey at Purchaser's expense within [15] days of the DD Start Date.

### 9. Closing Costs
Each party shall pay its own attorney's fees. [SPECIFY LOCAL CUSTOM: e.g., "Transfer
taxes, title insurance, and recording fees to be split per local custom / paid by
Purchaser / paid by Seller."] [VERIFY local Baton Rouge / parish custom with closing
attorney.]

### 10. Brokerage
[OPTION A — No broker:] Each party represents that no real estate broker or agent was
involved in this transaction and each party shall indemnify the other for any brokerage
claim arising from that party's conduct.

[OPTION B — Broker acknowledged:] Purchaser acknowledges that [BROKER NAME] represents
[Seller / Purchaser]. Seller shall be responsible for all brokerage commissions per
separate agreement. Purchaser shall owe no commission to any broker except as separately
agreed in writing.

### 11. Purchaser Entity / Assignment
Purchaser is Ridgeback Peak Properties LLC, a Louisiana limited liability company, or
its assigns. Purchaser reserves the right to assign this LOI or the resulting Purchase
Agreement to an entity in which Purchaser or its principals hold a controlling interest,
without Seller consent, for the purpose of taking title through a per-deal special
purpose entity. Such assignment shall not release Purchaser from its obligations.

### 12. Confidentiality
Each party agrees to keep the terms of this LOI and any due diligence materials received
from the other party confidential except as required by law or disclosed to advisors,
lenders, and investors on a need-to-know basis.

### 13. Non-Binding / Exclusivity
This LOI is non-binding and creates no enforceable obligation except with respect to
[OPTION: "exclusivity" — Seller shall not negotiate with or accept offers from other
parties for [30] days following mutual execution of this LOI.] This LOI supersedes all
prior discussions. Either party may terminate negotiations at any time prior to execution
of a Purchase Agreement.

### 14. Expiration
This LOI expires if not countersigned and returned by [DATE / "5:00 PM CT on [DATE]"].
